ce_que_tu_regles_pour_toi: What you set for yourself: where replies to your sends arrive, your booking link.
sinon_celle_de_l_organisation: If empty, replies go to the organization’s reply address ({email}).
sinon_ton_adresse_de_connexion: If empty, replies go to your sign-in address.
calendly_ou_autre: Calendly or other — insertable in one click into emails and templates.
l_adresse_de_reponse_ne_semble_pas_valid: The reply address doesn’t look valid.
le_lien_de_rendez_vous_ne_semble_pas_val: The booking link doesn’t look valid (it starts with https://).

calendly.les_rendez_vous_pris_arrivent_tout_seuls: An appointment booked on Calendly creates the contact if needed, lands on their page, and stops automatic sending for that contact.
calendly.cree_le_dans_calendly_integrations_api: Create it in Calendly → Integrations → API & webhooks → Personal access token. It is used once and never stored.
calendly.le_jeton_sert_une_fois_webhooks_plans_pa: The token is used once (to create the webhook subscription) then forgotten. Calendly webhooks require a paid plan (Standard, Teams…) — manual appointment entry works without one.
calendly.la_deconnexion_est_locale_retire_aussi_l: Disconnecting is local: since your token was never stored, remove the webhook subscription on Calendly’s side by hand (Calendly → Integrations → Webhooks).
calendly.connectee_les_rendez_vous_arriveront_tou: Calendly connected: booked appointments will now land on contact pages by themselves.
calendly.deconnectee_pense_a_retirer_le_webhook: Calendly connection disconnected: nothing will be written anymore. Remember to also remove the webhook on Calendly’s side (Integrations → Webhooks).
